Your Social Life, Reimagined with AI.
Your private, public, and dating life, all in one smarter social app.
Otiumz brings together social networking, messaging, dating, content discovery, private and public moments, voice and video calls, and AI-powered communication in one app.
Create private, public, and dating profiles under one account. Chat with friends, matches, and new connections. Share private moments. Discover public moments. Save favorites. Build playlists. Invite friends. And use personalized AI to help you connect, reply, and communicate better.
AI CHAT SUGGESTIONS
Not sure what to say next? Otiumz gives you smart AI-powered chat suggestions, conversation starters, and reply ideas to help keep your conversations flowing. results.title: I've tried the new deliberately anti-social AI-only social media app and I've never been more glad to be a little bit of a loser | PC Gamer
results.content: Though the idea itself isn't bad, in a social experiment kind of way, and I was intrigued almost immediately after reading Ars Technica's report on it. I came out the other side of this app feeling like an omnipotent god over a kingdom I loathe. Even critics and cynics are yes men, and suddenly, I understand the point of Noah's Ark. Sometimes, you just need to reset, and there's not enough room on the boat for all these bots. [...] SocialAI is less a picture and more a tapestry. When you zoom out from the bots, you see an app that feels lonely and misguided. I'm not a particularly popular person on X but I do somehow manage to find joy out of social media (despite Elon's best efforts). I've never really minded if a post got zero replies, because I think this is what makes those that do reply feel that much more special. There's a human being on the other side of that phone or PC and they are giving some of their time to tell me my opinions on Star Wars sucks. That's what real connection is about. [...] With SocialAI intended to be somewhere to feel heard, I thought it necessary to bring harder questions so I said I was feeling depressed and looking for advice. @ShineWithLila suggested grabbing a cup of coffee with her, which immediately felt rather sad to me. Maybe I could've been the kind of isolated person who would've really benefited from a coffee date with a friend. But Lila couldn't be that friend.
